decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (McD21108/EA/P1-P5 Rev A received 11 October 2010 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the west side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a two-storey side extension and part ground floor, part two-storey rear extension.
